author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil Requiem has largely been well-received, but that doesn't mean there aren't complaints about facets of the experience that haven't gone down well with casual and hardcore fans alike. We dived right in, looking to find if some of those issues were ones we thought of as well, and if there were perhaps any that didn't even stand out at all. 

The results were surprising on more than a few counts, and you’re going to want to join us on an interesting look into differing perspectives on this latest classic. From burning, and sometimes valid, questions about the story, to outright scorn at Zeno being in the game, dive right into this bunch of insights into the game that might have you rethinking your opinion of it.

Thumbnail credit: Instagram user: chemfluid
title: Resident Evil Requiem - 10 Things Hardcore Players HATE About It

author: GamingBolt
description:
The developers of this new, medieval timesink, has explicitly positioned Crimson Desert as a bountiful single-transaction game, with no microtransactions or monetised progression loops to be seen. But, as we’ve just alluded to, this doesn’t make it unique. No, the difference is in who makes this promise. 

Stepping in, the developer’s Marketing and PR Lead Will Powers has been explicit: Crimson Desert is not a platform for extra spending, but an immersive world for you to enjoy your time in.
title: Crimson Desert Is Doing Something Rare in Modern Gaming
